balls.text: outside edge and four! Bravo's gone for 10, with the last ball giving the batsman some width yet again and that has flown away over the wicket-keeper for four!
opens the face of the bat, guides it to third-man for a single
width again, outside the off stump, gets the outside edge to third-man, on the bounce for a single
length ball and tries to cut it yet again, misses, through to the keeper
cut away through point, that should have been fielded by the deep point fielder, goes through the fielder. Too much width there
short of length, goes on to the back foot, defended to the point fielder
tries to cut it away, but gets it straight to point and that ends a rather short spell from Ashwin, where he has bowled two overs for 13 runs
pushed to the off side for a single
quicker one, hits him on his pads, misses, there was an appeal but given not-out
wicket for Ashwin, lbw, carrom ball! This was pitching in line, quicker too, swung it across the line, missed and was caught plumb in front
and this time he connects, it is a huge six, over mid-wicket, cruel, cruel life!
goes down the pitch, wanted to hit it over long-off, instead gets some sort of a leading edge and it has gone high in the air, dropped by Srikanth!
tries to slog it across the line, hits the pads and scoots up through the slips for a four leg-byes!
driven to short cover, it was pitched up, to the fielder, but the unnecessary throw gets them an extra run
swept away and finally a four, that gets them to their 100
tries to slog it away, goes to deep mid-wicket for a single
driven to the bowler, no run again
slog attempted, bowled! The run-rate needed to climb, Botha had played out 19 balls for his 12 and he was under pressure to get some away, tried to go for a big one but missed
pitched right up to bat, slightly slower, driven to deep mid-wicket for only a single
too short and wide, cut away for a single to deep point
pitched right up tot the bat here, driven to the long-on region for a single
quicker, some bounce too, and cut attempted, missed, through to the keeper
on the back foot, punched back to the bowler, they are going nowhere
quicker ball, pulled away for a single to deep square-leg.
short ball, pulled away to deep fine-leg for a single
some room given, pushed to the off side for a single
opens the face of the bat to short third-man for a single
driven to short mid-on and they still don't get a run
tries to play it to the leg side, hits his pads
reverse sweep attempted, hits his pads, but the impact was outside the off stump
pitched right up to the bat and that has been driven to wide long-off, where they are able to come back for the second
there were two fielders in the point region for this one, pitched up and it has been drilled to deep point for a couple of runs
drilled through covers for a four, half volley outside the off stump and that has been spanked
goes down the track to get it away, Bravo slows the pace down and Hodge can only push it back to the bowler
nips back, Botha was rooted to his crease and finally manages to get some bat there, goes to square-leg for a single
bouncer but it was far too high, and wide called
leading edge off the bat of Hodge, flies to third-man for a single
on his pads, fuller and that is played away to the short fine-leg for a single
defended on his front foot, back to the bowler
on his pads, a bit of turn from there, Hodge misses and it hits the pads
shortish outside the off stump, cut away for a single
short of length, goes on to the back foot and defended back
length ball, easily goes on to the back foot and tapped to the leg side for a single
on his pads, flicked to wide mid-on and this time they are able to come back for their second run
on the off stump, pitched slightly up, he was still on his back foot trying to cut it away, goes to point and they don't get any run
outside the off stump, pitched up to the bat and pushed to the deep point fielder for a single
pitched up this time, driven to wide mid-on for a single
short of the length, Botha goes on to the back foot, defends it back to the bowler, almost like a weak forehand shot.
outside the off stump, short of length, it deserved to be cut, but misses
bit shorter this time, pushed to the off side for a single
fuller, defended on the front foot and the bowler fields on his follow through
outside the off stump, played away to the short third-man for a single
pats it to the off side and they are off for a quick single here
on the middle stump, pitched up, defended back to the bowler
tapped away to the leg side for a quick single, a direct hit would have been the end of the batsman.
outside the off stump and that's cut away to deep point for a single
on the off stump, does not bounce too much, defended back to the bowler
length ball, on the back foot and defended to the off side for nothing.
on the middle, tapped away to mid-on for a single
short ball and pulled away straight to short mid-wicket, Raina was brought there before this ball and it goes straight to him, Binny's cameo has ended.
on his pads, half volley and that has been flicked away between fine-leg and deep square-leg for a four, what a stroke!
opens the face of the bat and through to third-man for a single, 18 off that over!
down the track and Bravo has been spanked over the long-off fence for a six! Would you believe it, Hilfy bowled four overs at this end for eight runs and Bravo has done nothing of that kind
punched through point for a four! This was a decent ball, a bit of width, he went down and opened the face of the bat, beats the third-man
quicker, down the leg side, flicks his pads through to square-leg for a leg-bye
short and that would have been a wide in Test matches too, outside the off stump. What a poor start after the Time Out
this time it is on the middle stump, driven to mid-on and they are off for a single, the mid-on fielder throws the stumps down at the non-striker's end but the batsman is in
short ball, cut away for four through the point region! Poor ball, half tracker and Binny had it easy
on the off stump, taps to the off side for a single. And would you believe it, we have a Strategic Time-Out.
on his pads, fuller, nudged away to deep square-leg for a single to open his account
way outside the off stump and that is a very wide wide!

goes down the track and he is gone, caught! Rahane was getting frustrated at his inability to score runs, he tried to take on Mahesh, gets the toe end of the bat and it ballooned up for Ashwin to take a simple catch at mid-on
outside the off stump, fuller this time, driven on the up to long-off, was in air but misses the short cover fielder
short ball, wanted to go for the pull, misses the stroke and collected by the keeper.
outside the off stump, tries to cut it but it goes hard into the ground, Mahesh fails to field it on his follow-through, a single to long-off
outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat, guides it to the third-man region for a single. That is the end of an excellent Hilfenhaus spell.
outside the off stump, short of length, and Rahane is compact in his back-foot defence.
on the off stump, moves away and drives it through point for a single
gives himself room yet again, gets an inside edge through to fine-leg, Raina gives chase from slips and stops the boundary. The ball was slowing down on this heavy outfield
bounce off a length ball, outside the off stump, misses the cut, probably was too quick for him
pitched further up this time, defended on the back-foot, back to the bowler
pitched up this time, outside the off stump, caressed through the off side for a single to deep cover
goes down the track, this is now sent across the off side, too far out there as well, and that is the second successive wide
way down the leg side, the batsman barely moved his bat, called a wide
dropped! Edged away by Rahane, there was a slip waiting, Raina, he dived a tad too late to his right and it hits his palms and rolls away
short of length yet again, he goes on to the back foot and pushes it to square-leg for a single
walks down the track and nudges it to the square-leg for a single
short of length, outside the off stump and he goes for a cut, misses and the keeper collects
pitched right up to the bat, outside the off stump, driven back to the bowler
short of length and defended on the back-foot, end of an excellent over from Hilfenhaus. End of the spell too?
short ball, on the off stump, moving away and Binny was at sea playing that one, mind you not too many would have played it any better, lets it go in the end.

out, caught at third-man? Outside edge from Watson, it flew to the third-man fielder, Ashwin makes a lot of ground, dives and holds on, but they are checking now. Yes, it is out, an excellent camera angle and there was no doubt about that one.
that is an ugly slog again, first it was Dravid and now it is Rahane who tries to heave it away, gets an outside edge to third-man, but on the bounce
outside edge to third-man for a single, that was also just back of length and moving away from the batsman, he opens the face of the bat for a single
length ball, bounce on it as well, plays it to third-man, gets it high on the bat, single for the batsman
almost, almost a wicket! Good length ball and Watson tried to drive it on the up, falls just short of the extra-cover fielder
a bit short of good length, outside the off stump, whipped it to the right of mid-on for a single
pitched right up to the bat, driven to the covers but straight to a fielder
length ball, better line from Morkel, within the stumps, punched back but well fielded by the bowler on his follow-through
short of length, goes on to the back foot, defended on the back foot
Morkel continues to dole out poor deliveries, and this is short, wide and cut over the in-field for four. After a good Hilfenhaus over, this is not the best you can dish out
Three in a row! This was slightly fuller, but enough to send him on the back foot, Watson tried to defend it but it whizzes past the outside edge of the bat.
another one, length ball and that has bounced a lot more than Watson expected, beats the outside edge!
short of length, lot of bounce on this one, and Watson misses it
good length ball yet again, on the middle stump, punched to the leg side for a single
good length and that is missed yet again by Rahane.
good length ball, defended on the back foot
and a over pitched one down the leg side yet again, but Watson misses this and there is a bit of a stifled appeal, aborted and negated.
outside the off stump, good length, defended to the off side
punched through the on-side for four! That was a bad ball but Watson took full toll of it, it was drifting down, half volley and Watson's hit it through mid-wicket
good delivery, probably Morkel's best of the innings so far, outside the off stump, makes the batsman reach out and then gets it to move away
good length, bit of bounce, tapped away to square-leg, the fielder at short fine-leg runs around, but not before they are through for a single
flicked away to the square-leg fence for a four! It was going down the leg side and to add to that sin, it was a half-volley, drilled to the deep field for a four.
pitched on the off-stump, length ball, deviated away and missed his bat, hits the pads, bounces between the wicket-keeper and slips and trickles away for a four. Should have been stopped by Dhoni
ugly shot from a usually beautiful stroke-player, tried to play across the line, gets a bit of a top edge and it goes to Hussey at mid-off, Dravid's gone!
too close to cut, pitched up and a bit of movement still, tries to cut again but he has not got that going, misses the bat.
outside the off stump and a bit of movement away from the bat, misses the bat and goes through to the wicket-keeper
down the leg side, fails to get any bat on it hits his pads, and it rolls away for a leg-bye
on the stumps, short of length, pushed back to the bowler
short of a good length, on to the back foot, punched back to the bowler
down the leg side and Dravid was looking to get some bat on it, but as it turns out, it is a wide
on the good length, on the off stump, moving a little away and defended back to the bowler
pulls his length back, outside the off stump, left alone by the batsman.
pitched right up to the bat and cover-driven, no swing there and it has been caressed through the extra-cover region for a four.
outside the off stump, exactly like the first one, some 55 minutes ago, and Dravid misses out yet again, cuts it to the covers again
outside the off stump, bit short, and Dravid cuts the long hop straight to the cover fielder
down the leg side and it is four wides! Tait has had an excellent first three overs but he has bowled three of the worst balls you would see at this stage. The Super Kings win easily in the end!
yorker, shuffled across and bowled, but Tait over-steps! No-ball called and that is a big break for the Super Kings. Free Hit
pitched up and swung over mid-wicket for six!
goes on to the back foot, tapped away to the leg side for a single
cut away through the covers for four, full-toss delivered by Watson and the batsman carves it through point. The fielder was up in the circle and he did that very easily
short ball and six! Would you believe it, Srikkanth has smashed it over mid-wicket for a six! The game has swung hugely here...
gives room, drilled away but straight to extra cover, Dravid had the chance to run Morkel out, but had one stump to aim at, misses.
short of length, outside the off stump and Morkel wanted to smack it away, bounces hard into the ground and Watson dives to his left to stop it from going to long-on
pitched up and tonked powerfully over long-on for a six! Match turns around again and that brings the required rate to around eight
tries to pull it away, gets an inside edge and they are off for a single
short  ball, pull shot, top-edge and four! Good over in terms of runs for the Super Kings, as this one is top-edged over the wicket-keeper for a boundary
pitched up and that has been hit over long-off for a six! Did not hit the middle of the bat and for a brief moment, Rajasthan fans would have fancied a wicket, just clears the long-off fielder
length ball, outside the off stump, dabbed it to the off side for a single
short ball, very, very short and down the leg side, wide called by the umpire. Not a bad idea bouncing him but that was rather short.

down the track and caught at long-off! He had hit a boundary off the first ball of the over but he went down the pitch for this one and tried to clear the long-off fence, mistimed it and its gone straight to the fielder on the boundary.
outside the off stump, pitched right up to the bat, and driven through the covers for four! Good start for Chennai after the break!
cut away, caught, is that the match? short ball and the absent third-man was an open invite, Dhoni went for a full bloodied cut, but straight to the point fielder and is caught!
on the pads, short of length, nudged away to deep square-leg for a single
tries to play that late again, Jadeja is beaten by the movement again, jagging in and the bounce makes him fend it away
shortish ball, does not come on too well for Dhoni, pulled but goes to long-on for a single
goes on to the back foot, wanted to play it through the leg side, misses it and hits the pads
back of length, comes into the batsman, gets a bit of a bounce too, tries to late late cut it, gets only a single
pitched right up to the bat, drilled down to the long-on for a single
short of length, almost expecting the batsman to come down the track, Dhoni pushes it to one of the deep fielders on the leg side for a single
full length, on the leg stump, around 100 km/hr, driven to long-on for a single
fullish on the leg stump, Dhoni pushes it to the leg side for a single
does not pitch it up to the bat this time, Dhoni defends it back to the bowler
pitched right up and Dhoni smacks it over the in-field, what was impressive about the shot was that it hits the gap between deep mid-wicket and long-on, one bounce four
another one which is short of a good length, this time Dhoni gets an inside edge to it, rolls to the deep square-leg and the captain gets a single. He wanted a second but is sent back
short of a good length, and he tries to flick it away, misses, hits the pads
on the stumps, pitched fuller this time, taps it to the off side but straight back to the bowler
pulls his length back, Dhoni is going the track to tap it away some place, hits his pads and rolls back to the bowler
short of length, pushed to the leg side for a single
goes down the wicket to the bowler and smacks it over long-on for a six, some unchaining of the shackles!
short of length, goes on to the back foot, defended back to the bowler, 146.4 km/hr
short ball, very quick again, 148.2 km/hr and he goes for the pull, gets a top-edge and falls just short of the fine-leg fielder! Things have suddenly begun to happen here!
length ball, outside the off stump and he tries to cut it without moving his feet, misses.
pitched right up, really quick, 147.4 km/hr, Jadeja dug it out to mid-off and wanted a single, Dhoni did not and there was a bit of confusion there
pitched up, on his pads, tries to flick it, hits the pads again

gone, run-out! Crazy running from Dhoni and Hussey, total lack of communication and that results in the demise of Hussey. It was pitched up, hits his pads and Hussey wanted a single, was sent back, before Dhoni also showed some interest, there were many 'yeses' and 'nos' within a couple of seconds. In the mean time, the bowler got to the ball, threw it back and hit the stumps!
short of good length, punched back to the bowler and that finishes the over off, which cost only three
outside the off stump, punched to the wide mid-off region and they are off for a single, misfield there by Dravid, who got a bobble there and they are off for a second
down the leg side, he was probably trying a quicker one but misdirected.
on the middle stump, pitched up and the captain defends it back to the bowler
outside the off stump, short of length, punched back to the bowler, to the left of the bowler and that just evades his lunging hands, almost a catch!
pulled away and caught! This might make it exciting, shorter one, Bravo pulled it away to deep square-leg for the fielder to judge it well and take the catch!
outside the off stump, a bit of movement, pushed to the off side by Bravo
short ball and cut away but straight to the fielder at point
pitched up and drilled to long-on for a single
dabbed to the leg side and it goes to the right of short mid-wicket, a bit of a chase and they get back for a single
goes down the track, pitched right up, almost yorks himself, played to the off side
a little shorter this time, turning away from the left-hander batsman, nudged away to the leg side for a single
pitched up, driven back to the bowler
bouncer from Trivedi, Bravo prefers to duck under it, goes through to the keeper. A harsher umpire may have called that a wide, it was a little down the leg side
length ball, on his pads, still bit of movement, played to fine-leg for a single
goes down the track, short of a good length, he had rolled his fingers over that one, and that got it to bounce a little more, guided to third-man
outside the off stump again, this time a little slower, gets the cut going, for a single to deep point
length ball, outside the off stump, keeps a little low and Hussey misses his cut
on his body, short of good length, tries to dab it to the leg side, gets a bit of a leading edge, goes to deep square-leg for a single
stylish flick to long-on for a single, taking Bravo to five and the players to a Time-Out.
pitched right up to the batsman, who drives to long-off for a single
defended off the back foot to the off side
a very good shot, inside-out through the extra-cover region for four, not too much power but amazing placement
defended on the front foot, to the off side, near the wicket-keeper
fuller ball, on the middle and driven to long-on for a single
length ball, tried to open the face of the bat, gets an inside edge and misses the top of the stumps!
round the wicket, pitches on the off stump and nips back drastically into the batsman, Hussey has been there since the start of the innings, and he is still hit on the pads because of the swing
outside the off stump and pushed to the deep cover for a single
outside the off stump, short of good length and a bit of movement away from the bat, defended on the back foot
pulls up the length this time, outside the off stump, punches to deep cover for a single
outside the off stump, pitched up, and driven to short cover
full-toss this time, driven to short cover and it was fielded well, had that gone through, it could have raced away for a four
on the middle stump, slower, defended back to the bowler
fuller, outside the off stump, driven through the covers for a single
pushed to the leg side but this time it goes straight to the fielder
on the middle stump, pushed to the off side for a single
bit shorter, nudged away to the leg side to get off the mark

outside the off stump, gives himself room to play it over extra-cover, driven in the air and caught! That was an excellent catch, it went high in the air, as much as the catch dropped by Srikanth had, but Rahane did well to get under it and take it easily! What was Raina doing playing that stroke, I do not know.
pitched right up to bat, driven but straight to short cover for no run
wanted to open the face of the bat, gets a bit of a leading edge, but goes down.
outside the off stump,pushed into the covers
on the off stump, good length and he has punched it to the off side and in the air, the field was coming in to stop the singles and it loops over the covers fielder
short from the bowler and Raina has swivelled across and pulled it away over backward deep square-leg region for a four!
pitched right up to the bat, Raina pushes it into the covers and they are away for a single
quick, outside the off stump, pitched up and Raina had nothing to do with it.
quick, really fast, short of length, jumps up and takes his bottom hand away, played away to the leg side for a single
outside the off stump and Hussey leaves that again, but this is quite close to the stumps, misses it.
outside the off stump, short of length, and Hussey leaves it alone.
pitched right up to Hussey, swinging into him and late, gets the bat down in time, played away to square-leg
outside the off stump, length ball, defended on the off side
third four in the over, it was drifting down the leg side, and a half volley, he flicks it through square-leg for another four, good start for Raina
outside the off stump and crashed through the off side for a four! There are two slips in place and that is leaving a lot of gap on the off side, punches it through covers
on the back foot to a length ball, punched it back to the bowler, who is still not happy with that four earlier!
and now he gets beaten! This was pushed up to the bat, outside the off stump, Raina wanted to drive it, misses the outside edge of the bat
short ball and that is boxed away over square-leg! Raina did not have too much of a back-left and he pulled it away for a four!
pitched up, swinging into the batsman, but drifting down the leg side and that is called a wide.
another one on the length, swinging back into the batsman, hits Hussey on his pads, he wanted a single, but Raina sends him back.
left on the bounce, on the off stump, swinging into the bat, length ball and he lets it go. Bounces over the stumps
pitched up, driven to mid-off where Binny fields well to prevent the single
whoa, what a nasty delivery, Hussey is at sea playing that one, short of length and rears up at the batsman, tried to evade it but hits the gloves and almost carries to slips
length ball, outside the off stump, left it alone for the wicket-keeper to hold on to.
another wide, outside the off stump this time, short ball, quick again and Hussey lets it go for the umpire to call the extra
another wide, but it was quick, down the leg-side, 150.4 km/hr, even beats the wicket-keeper with the late swing, they get two wides
outside the off stump, length ball, left alone and it is called a wide by the umpire
quick ball, outside the off stump, 148.2 km/hr, pitched right up, defended back to the off side and they are off for a single
now that is some timing, outside the off stump and Raina punches that good length ball on the up, through wide mid-off, there was no way anyone was getting close to that one.
outside the off stump, had a chance to hit it in the gap but misses his timing, gets something of an inside edge into the ground
good length ball, Raina's on the back foot, defended back to the bowler.
defended on the back foot, gets an outside edge and that goes through to the third-man for a single
pitched up to the bat, outside the off stump and Hussey manages to push it through the covers, beats the two fielders there and it goes through for a four
outside the off stump, short of length, beats the outside edge through to the keeper
gone, bowled! That was an excellent ball, pitched on the stumps and moving away, hits the top of the off stump and the bails are down!
on the back foot, punched to the point fielder
on the off stump, fuller, brings his foot forward and gets an inside edge on to his pads, loops up but a little away from the bowler
on the middle stump, was shaping to flick it away to the leg side, the ball seamed away a tad, squares him up and he checks his shot
length ball, swing away from the bat, the batsman lets it go and the keeper collects it on the bounce.
pitched up, on the off stump, driven to wide mid-off for a single
